note: Synthetic values for a teaching scenario; not taken from any real vehicle programme.

safety_req.text: Avoid unintended full braking at speeds above 10 km/h

architecture.diversity: different SoC vendors and software teams

decomposed_requirements: FSR-AEB-01a: fusion ECU limits brake request (ASIL B(D))
FSR-AEB-01b: radar monitor vetoes implausible brake request (ASIL C(D))

safety_req.text: Avoid unintended steering torque above 3 Nm

decomposed_requirements: FSR-LKA-01a: controller bounds torque request (ASIL B(D))
FSR-LKA-01b: limiter clamps torque above 3 Nm (ASIL A(D))
FSR-ACC-01a: controller limits acceleration request (ASIL B(C))
FSR-ACC-01b: torque monitor cuts excess torque (ASIL A(C))

safety_req.text: Avoid unintended lateral or longitudinal motion in traffic-jam assist

architecture.diversity: supervisor uses a simplified kinematic model

decomposed_requirements: FSR-TJA-01b: supervisor triggers minimal-risk manoeuvre (ASIL B(D))

safety_req.text: Avoid unintended vehicle motion above 7 km/h during automated parking

decomposed_requirements: FSR-APA-01a: controller limits speed request (ASIL A(B))
FSR-APA-01b: brake ECU limiter caps speed (ASIL A(B))
